messages:
alex: Kicking off staged rollout r2.3.4 -> 1% canary (EU-west + US-east). Deploy bot posted notes. Change window til 22:00 UTC. Watch p95 latency, GPU mem, and kv-cache evictions. If anything looks bad call stop.
deploy-bot: r2.3.4 canary started by alex. Targets: eu-west (1%), us-east (1%). Release notes: https://internal.releases/r2.3.4 :rocket:
maria: seeing p95 token latency jump in eu-west c3 nodes, spiked ~60% starting 30s ago. Error rate low but some tail latencies.
jin: grabbing logs from the affected hosts. looks like kvcache eviction storms + OOM traces in the runtime. snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z runtime: kvcache_evictions=482, alloc_failures=12
runtime: gpu_mem_free=120MB, kv_cache_entries=0
panic: OOM on allocate kv_entry
```

jin: full logs uploaded to /infra/logs/r2.3.4/eu-west/ -> https://logs.internal/eu-r2.3.4
leo: probable regression introduced by v2-quant's new kvcache allocator. Suggest pin eu-west to v1 variant and stop further traffic there. Leave us-east at 1% for now.
alex: requesting stop/go — @sre-oncall you good to take eu-west stop and rollback to v1? we want minimal blast radius.
sre-oncall: stop for eu-west. initiating rollback for that cohort and pin to v1. Running rollback command now: `deployctl rollback --release r2.3.4 --region eu-west --target v1 --reason "kvcache OOMs"`
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: job-88231. eu-west canary traffic set to 0% and pinned to v1. Notifying CDNs and routing. ETA ~45s.
maria: metrics confirming — p95 trending back down within 2m, kv_evictions dropping. No increase in 5xx.
leo: good signal. leaving eu-west pinned until a patch (r2.3.4-hotfix1) with allocator fix. we should also add a config flag to disable the new allocator by default during staged rollouts.
alex: agreed. action items: 1) jin open hotfix branch and link to this thread, 2) release notes update saying eu-west pinned + rollback, 3) product ops notify stakeholders. resume us-east 1% only.
jin: hotfix branch created: git/internal/r2.3.4-hotfix1, will run unit + canary on a single staging shard then propose redeploy.
alex: resuming us-east at 1% now (no changes to eu-west). anyone object? :thumbsup: to proceed
leo: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup: metrics look stable for us-east.
deploy-bot: us-east traffic resumed to 1% for r2.3.4. eu-west remains pinned to v1. Rollback note appended to release: https://internal.releases/r2.3.4/notes
alex: closing this stop/go. we'll reconvene if hotfix candidate shows green canary. thanks all.
